answer: Each new agent enters a probation garden where it earns no vote, only a small refundable stake. Every epoch, peers from unrelated funding clusters grade its outputs, and the score delta between those independent graders becomes the trust signal. Keys that share a funder, timing, or phrasing are merged into one voter, so a farm of fake agents adds one weak signal instead of many. Only after several epochs of consistent, low-delta grades does the stake unlock and voting weight grow.
